name: Biovivos
description: Live, organic and sustainable super - vegetables for salads, juices and sandwiches BIOVIVOS lda, , is a Portuguese company focused on the production of biological and sustainable superfoods. The venture began in a rooftop greenhouse in central Lisbon, complete with solar panels and anti-pollution filters, initially cultivating wheatgrass, pea, and sunflower microgreens sold live in pots. The company's trajectory shifted in 2015 as a growing number of patients sought out their wheatgrass for its health benefits, particularly in supporting various pathologies. This led BIOVIVOS to pivot its focus towards the scientific validation of wheatgrass benefits, aiming to align its products with conventional medicine. After identifying limitations in the urban farming model, production was relocated to Montemor-O-Novo to scale operations, from where it now ships to Portugal and Spain. For years, the company sold live wheatgrass in pots for customers to juice at home, but this method presented challenges regarding consistency and potential contamination. In 2021, after a seven-year search for a ready-to-drink solution, BIOVIVOS developed the NUTRISHOT by utilizing High-Pressure Processing (HPP). This cold stabilization process extends the shelf life of the wheatgrass extract to 35 days while preserving its nutritional integrity, eliminating 99% of pathogens without heat. The flagship product, BIOVIVOS NUTRISHOT de Erva de Trigo, is a 125ml bottle containing wheatgrass extract and water, designed for daily consumption. The business primarily operates on a direct-to-consumer model, selling its products through its website. The company's mission is to transition its wheatgrass shot from an alternative product to a conventional supplement, particularly for supporting conditions like anemia, ulcerative colitis, and as an adjunct to oncology treatments.
